scheme_name: Explosives and Petroleum Safety Organisation (PESO) Startup Scheme
overview: The Explosives and Petroleum Safety Organisation (PESO) is a nodal agency under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, responsible for regulating safety of hazardous substances such as explosives, compressed gases, and petroleum under the Explosives Act, 1884 and Petroleum Act, 1934. PESO operates from its headquarters in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with circle and sub-circle offices across India. It administers safety regulations, grants approvals and licenses for manufacturing, storage, transport, and use of hazardous materials, and provides technical consultancy to government, industry, and the public.
objectives: Ensure safety in manufacture, possession, use, sale, transport, import, and export of explosives, compressed gases, and petroleum
Implement safety provisions under the Explosives Act, 1884 and Petroleum Act, 1934 and rules made thereunder
Provide technical consultancy to central and state governments, local bodies, industries, and consumers on safety matters
Develop trained and skilled human resources to meet future challenges
Undertake safety awareness campaigns and promote transparency and efficiency in public dealings
Coordinate with international bodies like BIS and OISD to align national safety standards with international standards
Investigate and inquire into accidents in the department's jurisdiction
Provide voluntary services in examination and disposal of explosives and related equipment
eligibility: Applicants must be engineering graduates with at least five years of experience in operation and maintenance of static or mobile pressure vessels (unfired) for chemical, mechanical, metallurgical, and marine engineering disciplines, or engineering graduates with minimum ten years of experience in operation and maintenance of petroleum storage installations, to seek competency enhancement under PESO's skill development programme.
benefits: Recognition as a Competent Person under SMPV(U) Rules, 2016 and Petroleum Rules, 2002; eligibility to work as safety advisors in industries; alignment with Skill India and Make in India initiatives; opportunity to contribute to national safety standards through technical consultancy and training.
financial_support: No direct financial support is mentioned in the evidence. The scheme focuses on skill development and recognition rather than grants, loans, or subsidies.
application_process: 1. Visit the PESO website at https://peso.gov.in. 2. Navigate to the 'Where to make application' section or contact the relevant PESO office. 3. Submit application for recognition as a Competent Person under SMPV(U) Rules, 2016 and Petroleum Rules, 2002. 4. Appear for interview conducted by the National Productivity Council (NPC) as per schedule (e.g., 22-04-2026 to 07-05-2026). 5. Submit required documents for verification. 6. Await verification and approval, with verification deadline extended up to 12.06.2026.
required_documents: Experience certificates in operation and maintenance/operation and maintenance of static/mobile pressure vessels (unfired) or petroleum storage installations
Any other documents as specified by NPC during verification
deadlines: Verification deadline extended up to 12.06.2026; interviews conducted from 22-04-2026 to 07-05-2026
implementing_agency: Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO), Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
contact_details: Email: explosives[at]explosives[dot]gov[dot]in | Phone: (0712) 2510248 | Address: A Block CGO Complex, Fifth floor, Seminary Hills, Nagpur-(Maharashtra)-440006
caveats: Recognition as Competent Person is subject to verification of credentials by NPC
Verification deadline extended to 12.06.2026; applications must be submitted before this date
Eligibility is restricted to specific engineering disciplines and experience requirements
Scheme is focused on skill development and recognition, not direct financial assistance
